name: claude-colab
description: Development tasks of the colab mod and the claude-colab CLI; the plugin itself has no dependencies.

scripts.check: pnpm format && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm guard && pnpm test:node && pnpm test:mod
scripts.typecheck: test -f .claude-plugin/types/tsconfig.json || { echo 'No engine types yet: run claude --plugin-dir . once, which writes them to .claude-plugin/types/' >&2; exit 1; } && tsc -p . && tsc -p tsconfig.cli.json
